stem: Meera's mother dissolves salt in water while cooking at home. Meera wants to get the salt back from the salt solution. Which method will recover the salt from the solution?

options.text: Filtering the solution through filter paper
Heating the solution so the water evaporates, leaving the salt behind
Adding more salt to the solution
Cooling the solution in a refrigerator

teacher.key_rationale: Evaporation removes the water from a salt solution, leaving the dissolved salt as a solid residue, so B is correct. Filtration cannot separate a dissolved solid (A), adding more salt does not recover it (C), and cooling does not remove the water (D).
